approval: D009 approves D008 plan; AI implementation details below fixed before forecasting scores
target: sqrt(sum of next five valid consecutive exchange-session log-return squares)); no annualization/centering/imputation
baseline: sqrt(5/20 * sum of last 20 squared log returns through origin close))
market_donors: conservative policy for both experiments, exact focal-stock exclusion, contemporaneous eligible returns only
minimum_support_meaning: approved practical fit guard, not independent sample count or reference-stock reliability threshold
response: log strictly positive future volatility; exponentiate predictions without clipping or post-hoc calibration
fit_rows: M1 and M2 use identical complete own+market training rows within each policy to isolate feature addition
scaling: training-only StandardScaler per stock and fit
alpha_selection: one alpha per model family shared across stocks AND policies; minimize pooled tuning RMSPE on common observations under both policies; exact ties favor larger alpha
tuning_cohort: per-fold minimum training support under both policies, based only on labels ending before fold start
evaluation_cohort: minimum complete matured positive-target training support under BOTH policies before first 2015 origin; never based on later performance or survival
purge: training target_end strictly before first validation origin, training origin before it too
headline_sample: same valid stock/origin/target rows for all three models and both policies; retain zero targets for absolute metrics
zero_targets: preserve; exclude from log-target fitting and undefined percentage errors only; include available forecasts in MAE/RMSE; disclose counts
small_target_analysis: keep every eligible positive target in headline RMSPE; outcome bands use 2014 common tuning target quantiles 10/25/50/75/90; report loss shares from smallest 2015 1/5/10 percent, never trim and replace headline results
failure_cases: top five absolute and top five relative errors per policy/model, deterministic date/stock tie breaks; no price changes or invented economic causes
uncertainty: 1000 whole-calendar nonoverlapping block resamples of fixed out-of-sample forecasts, all stocks jointly; block lengths 20 and 60 sessions; descriptive paired metric differences, no significance guarantee
reserved_period: 2016–2018: no target/feature observations or scores loaded for this experiment
interpretation: 2015 internal discovery evaluation, previously examined descriptively; present actual evidence before lead interpretation/AI economic conclusions
